title: Aramco reports Q3 adjusted net income of $31.2 billion, up about 9%
detail: Aramco's third-quarter adjusted net income rose to $31.2 billion from $28.6 billion a year earlier; free cash flow was $28.2 billion and the base dividend was $21.9 billion. Arab News reported higher reported net income of $36.3 billion, aided by the sale of its PRefChem stake to Petronas. Nine-month adjusted net income reached $98.4 billion.
